title: Structure Pack Trio #12 (일반 셰브론·매끈 / 일반 폴카도트·물결 / 임산부 굵은 스트라이프·매끈 | 인어비늘+목재+드래곤비늘+뱀비늘 / 스테인드글라스+목재+뱀비늘 / 드래곤비늘+목재+공작눈무늬)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Ukrainian, in her late 50s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, cool ash-brown hair styled in sleek straight, real pores, real living eyes, 15 drop dangles piercings set with rubies in brass-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of silver earrings. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 chevron-shaped bands by 3 hazy transition zones, each shaped like a V pointing down with straight sides: each zone runs from one side edge of her figure sloping downward to the centre line, where it forms the tip of the V, then continues sloping upward to the opposite side edge. The tips of the V shapes sit about 25% of the way down her figure from the top, about 51% of the way down her figure from the top, about 74% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first V-shaped transition zone: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL scale formations, VIVID SILVER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the chevron band between V-shaped zone 1 and V-shaped zone 2: it carries rich dark walnut wood fused directly into her own form, natural grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep warm-brown grain with VIVID honey-gold highlight streaks. Region 3 is the chevron band between V-shaped zone 2 and V-shaped zone 3: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING ELECTRIC SAPPHIRE scale formations, VIVID DEEP COBALT scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is everything below the last V-shaped transition zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING WARM BRONZE scale formations, VIVID BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body, her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Japanese, in her mid 30s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, pale, almost translucent skin, heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips, a hollow, half-lidded expression, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in sleek straight, real pores, real living eyes, 150 hoops piercings set with opals in silver-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of silver an anklet. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is covered mainly by one background material, with 2 large round patches of other materials scattered irregularly across it, each patch roughly 25% of her figure's width across. Region 1 is the background: everything outside the round patches: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 2 is the round patch centred about 45% of the way down her figure from the top and about 54% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries deep black ebony wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING glossy jet-black grain with VIVID dark-brown highlight streaks. Region 3 is the round patch centred about 33% of the way down her figure from the top and about 80% of the way across her figure from her left edge: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The patch edges are hazy and feathered — there is no visible outline at all. Around each patch, a transition zone about a hand's width wide lets the patch's material and the background material dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each patch edge follows a gently rippled outline rather than a perfect circle. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out, her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#3: Jamaican, in her early 40s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, sleek silver-grey hair styled in a short pixie cut, real pores, real living eyes, 200 studs piercings set with diamonds in silver-toned metal, wearing a single piece of rose-gold a ring. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 thick diagonal stripes by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 27% of the way down her figure from the top, about 49% of the way down her figure from the top and about 75% of the way down her figure from the top. The stripes alternate between 3 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID AMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the diagonal stripe between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries rich reddish mahogany wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep red-brown grain with VIVID copper highlight streaks. Region 3 is the diagonal stripe between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP BLUE radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries the same material as Region 1. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
